title: Buck Clayton's lessons and the delicacy of teaching idols
summary: Jonah drags Buck Clayton to Maxwell's studio; Maxwell used to steal Buck's solos at the Apex Club.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Is he traveling now? Buck away?

Yeah, ever since he's been traveling. Because, you remember he had that concert in Paris when he got booed and he was crying. So Jonah said, "Well, look, I've been after you for six months." He said, "If you don't come down and see Jim, I'm going to drag you down."
Now, this other guy I used to stand down at the Apex Club on Central Avenue, listen to Buck, go home and try to remember what he'd played. How you going to charge a guy you

stole half your solos from, you know.

And to be a good teacher, you have to be an authority. Yet you've got men with -- you know, they don't have big egos in the sense that they're egotistical but they've got, you know, they're important people and they know they are. Now, you know, you can't treat them like a child. You've got to let that man keep his dignity but at the same time you do have to get in control. So it was the most ticklish thing I ever went through in my life.
